When throwing two standard dice (each with faces numbered 1-6), it's impossible to get a sum of 13.

The minimum sum you can get is 2 (when both dice show 1), and the maximum sum is 12 (when both dice show 6).

Therefore, the probability of getting 13 is **0**.
